title: Deluxe Scarecrow

{{Infobox |eng = Deluxe Scarecrow |source = [[Crafting]] |season = [[Spring]] • [[Summer]] • [[Fall]] |recipe = Letter after collecting all [[Scarecrow#Rarecrows|rarecrows]] |ingredients = {{Name|Wood|50}}{{Name|Iridium Ore|1}}{{Name|Fiber|40}} |sellprice = N/A }} The '''Deluxe Scarecrow''' is a craftable [[scarecrow]] that prevents crows from eating a player's crops. The player can obtain the recipe for a Deluxe Scarecrow only after obtaining all 8 [[Scarecrow#Rarecrows|rarecrows]], which will trigger the "Z.C. Rarecrow Society" to send the player a letter containing the recipe with a 90.5% probability each night until it is delivered. The Deluxe Scarecrow has double the radius (16) of that of a normal scarecrow (8), affecting a total of 888 tiles. ==Letter== {{Quote|Dear ,

Your dedication is truly impressive...

Only a select few manage to acquire the complete Rarecrow collection!

Please accept this blueprint to commemorate your achievement.|The Z.C.
